'''Vicki''' is a Bloom Bearer located at the {{Location|Modulation Hall}} and is seen arguing with the [[Tethys System]].

==Quests and Events==
{{Quests and Events|Vicki}}

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Aftermath of {{Quest|To the Shore's End}})
:'''Vicki:''' Tethys, I require... the list of all Bloom Bearers involved in this mission.
:'''Tethys System:''' This system is terribly sorry to inform you that all twelve Bloom Bearers in this mission have lost vital signs.
:'''Vicki:''' I'm not asking for statistics! I need their names!
:'''Tethys System:''' This system will manage the necessary follow-up procedures. Additional intervention is not required on your part...
:'''Vicki:''' I said, give me their names! Every single one of them!
:'''Tethys System:''' Niya, Igor, Suellen, Kresser, Margo, Meiji, Weidenfeller, Fritz, Valery, Nessa, Bangor, and Aleksei. Twelve Bloom Bearers in total.
:'''Tethys System:''' Follow-up protocol initiated. This system extends it condolences to all affected parties—
:'''Vicki:''' That won't be necessary. I'll handle it personally. Vicky, Bloom Bearer, code number 1258 y 057/4, proceeding to execute follow-up actions.
{{Dialogue End}}
